media_work.title: FRONTLINE
media_work.focus_or_theme: Plea bargaining system, innocent defendants pleading guilty, prosecutorial pressure, inadequate defense counsel, impact of poverty on justice outcomes.
media_work.summaryNotes: Highlights how the vast majority of cases are resolved through pleas, often pressuring innocent individuals.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Examination of the plea bargain system through cases like the Hearne, Texas drug sweep.
media_item.summary_notes: Focuses on Erma Faye Stewart and Regina Kelly, wrongly implicated in a drug sweep in Hearne, Texas, highlighting the pressures of the plea system, inadequate counsel, and unreliable informants. Stewart pleaded guilty despite innocence to care for her children, while Kelly fought the charges which were eventually dismissed.
key_quotes_raw: Stewart describing the pressure to take the plea to care for her children
Kelly discussing the inadequate time/advice from court-appointed counsel
Discussion of the informant's unreliability coming out later.
systemic_issues_raw: The overwhelming pressure of the plea bargain system, particularly on poor defendants
Inadequate resources and potential conflicts of interest for court-appointed attorneys
The devastating collateral consequences of a felony conviction (even via plea)
The potential for unreliable informants to cause widespread injustice
policy_recommendations_raw: Implied need for reform in the plea bargaining process
Better funding and oversight of indigent defense

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Felony drug distribution (pleaded guilty, maintained innocence)
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Wrongfully implicated in Hearne, Texas drug sweep based on unreliable informant. Pressured into pleading guilty to felony drug distribution despite innocence, primarily to be released from jail to care for her children. Received probation but faced collateral consequences.
contributing_factors_raw: Pressure to get out of jail for children
organizations_involved_raw: ACLU (represented co-defendant Kelly in subsequent lawsuit)

featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Wrongfully implicated in Hearne, Texas drug sweep based on unreliable informant. Arrested and jailed pre-trial, refused to plead guilty, and charges were eventually dismissed. Lead plaintiff in subsequent ACLU class-action lawsuit.
contributing_factors_raw: Arrest based on unreliable confidential informant
Racial bias alleged in drug sweep
